name: Power Automate
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Intelligent Applications Builder Associate (AB-410)
tools: Microsoft 365 apps: Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel and OneDrive

beginner.summary: For business users, team administrators and new makers who want to automate everyday Microsoft 365 work. Covers cloud flow types, triggers, actions and connectors, dynamic content and expressions, dates, conditions, loops and variables, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel and OneDrive flows, files and attachments, approvals, run history, sharing and ownership, templates and AI-assisted creation, and first desktop flows, in line with the Power Automate part of PL-900.
prerequisites: Uses Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel and OneDrive at work
Work or school account in a Microsoft 365 tenant (personal Microsoft accounts lost cloud flow access in July 2025)
Windows 10 or 11 PC where Power Automate for desktop can be installed
Power Automate Premium or trial licence for the premium connector and desktop flow labs
outcomes: Build automated, instant and scheduled cloud flows with Microsoft 365 connectors
Shape data with dynamic content, expressions, conditions, loops and variables
Run approvals and handle email, files, attachments and Excel data in flows
Read run history, fix failed runs, share flows safely and run a first desktop flow

intermediate.summary: For makers and automation developers who already build cloud flows and want to build integrated, reliable automations. Covers workflow definition language expressions and JSON, child flows, try-catch-finally error handling, retry policies, concurrency and pagination, HTTP actions and custom connectors, Dataverse triggers and actions, business process flows, approvals in depth, solution-aware flows with environment variables and connection references, desktop flows for UI, web, Excel and SAP GUI automation, AI Builder document processing, process and task mining, and testing and monitoring, in line with the automation domain of AB-410.
prerequisites: Builds automated, instant and scheduled cloud flows with conditions, loops and expressions
Has run a desktop flow from a cloud flow
Power Automate Premium licence and maker access to a Dataverse environment
Reads JSON and knows what a REST API request and response are
outcomes: Write expressions and JSON handling that keep flows short and readable
Build reusable flows with child flows, try-catch-finally scopes, retry policies and concurrency settings
Integrate REST APIs, custom connectors and Dataverse in solution-aware flows
Build reliable desktop flows for UI, web, Excel and SAP GUI and add AI Builder and process mining

advanced.summary: For automation architects, RPA leads and platform owners who run automation across an organisation. Covers automation architecture and the choice between cloud flows, desktop flows, Azure Logic Apps and code, attended and unattended RPA at scale with machine groups, hosted machine groups and work queues, request limits and throttling, design for volume, security of connections and service principals, data policies, an automation centre of excellence, monitoring at scale, ALM pipelines, process mining programmes, agent flows and AI, migration from UiPath, Blue Prism and legacy workflows, operations and incidents, licensing and capacity, and programme leadership.
prerequisites: Has built and supported solution-aware cloud flows and desktop flows in production
Uses connection references, environment variables, scopes and Dataverse in flows
Power Platform administrator or environment administrator access to a test tenant
outcomes: Design automation architectures and choose the right engine for each workload
Run attended and unattended RPA at scale with machine groups, hosted machine groups and work queues
Secure, govern, monitor and deploy automations within platform limits
Lead an automation programme through migration, AI adoption, operations and licensing decisions
